title: Intel — Project Arena
line: A virtual arena for the Intel i9 demonstration
notes: The Glimpse Group subcontracted the Intel Project Arena work. The virtual arena used thousands of attendees and complex particle effects to demonstrate the i9 before its public release. The source says there was no follow-up or repeat contract. A paid experiment can build capability without becoming a recurring pipeline.
